reading: Joined by terms, a reading: Zid's Store Design (تصميم المتجر), its dashboard section where the merchant customizes the store's design, logo and icon (لوحة التحكم > تصميم المتجر, ZD-S-1073), and its product line E-store (ZD-S-0447), are Salla's Store design (SA-S-1828) and Shopify's Online Store, whose plan row is Themes and templates (SH-S-7003). Strained (S1): the concern is the whole Store Design plan group, and its lines are cited in other trees: Search Bar, Filtering and Filter Criteria & Options (ZD-I-0326, ZD-I-0330, ZD-I-0331) in CM-SFR-013; the main menu plan line (ZD-S-1074) in CM-CNT-005; Manage additional pages (ZD-I-0539) in CM-CNT-003; API's > Storefront [Store Scripts] (ZD-S-0051) in CM-SFR-012, tree CM-SFR-011. Its theme-code lines (ZD-S-1001, ZD-S-1002, ZD-S-1075, ZD-I-0329) and Landing Page (ZD-I-0332) are in this tree (CM-SFR-002, CM-SFR-006).

Joined by terms: Zid's Theme Market (سوق الثيمات), "a platform owned by Zid holding many free or paid themes, so the merchant can design the store" (ZD-S-0895), with partners' themes sold in it (ZD-S-0897, ZD-S-0899), is Salla's Theme Marketplace (SA-S-1829) and Shopify's Theme Store. A reading.

Joined by terms: Zid's domains (قائمة النطاقات, ZD-S-0948; Custom Domain Linking / ربط دومين خاص, ZD-S-0950; the zid.store subdomain, ZD-S-0952) are Salla's Domain (SA-S-2040, linking a third party's domain) and Shopify's Domains (SH-S-1497). A reading.

A join on role, a reading: Zid's API's groups (Authentication, Checkout, Products, Categories, Account, Storefront, Countries), apart from its Merchant APIs, are called with the Role header set to Customer "to perform operations as a customer" (ZD-S-0894), the role of Salla's storefront APIs (SA-S-5140) and WooCommerce's Store API for customer-facing cart, checkout and product functionality (WC-S-0914). No Zid statement names them a storefront API; the group API's > Storefront (ZD-I-0051) is one of them. Landed in CM-SFR-012, not its parent CM-SFR-011: no Zid statement shows headless or custom storefronts.

A join on role, a reading: Zid's legal pages (الصفحات القانونية, Settings > Store > Legal pages, ZD-S-0779), whose kinds are the privacy policy, terms and conditions, return and exchange policy, complaints and suggestions, and licences (ZD-S-0780), are the store's published policies: Shopify's Settings > Policies (SH-S-7087) and Salla's information pages carrying the policies (SA-S-2100). Strained (S1): its API's > Storefront [Pages] (ZD-S-0783) names pages, not legal pages, and is cited in CM-CNT-003, another tree.

Joined by terms: Zid's blog (المدونة, لوحة التحكم > المتجر الإلكتروني > المدونة, ZD-S-1040; Merchant APIs > Blogs, ZD-S-0936) is Salla's Blog (SA-S-1698) and Shopify's Blog posts (SH-S-1527). A reading. Zid puts it under the dashboard's E-store section (ZD-S-1040); CM-CNT-004 stays under CM-CNT-003 by the anchor's grouping.

Zid's URL redirects (خاصية إعادة توجيه الروابط, Settings > URL redirects, ZD-S-0967): a new capability, since no capability of the model holds redirects (CM-CNT-006 Custom URLs keeps apart from them, by its note) and `caps` finds none in another domain (terms redirect; إعادة توجيه). A reading. Gaps: what turns it on is `observation needed` and no API is held (ZD-C-102/decides, ZD-C-102/boundary).

A join on role, a reading: Mazeed (مزيد), "a platform/app for e-commerce that lets Zid's merchants show and sell products and lets customers shop them" (ZD-S-0984), with Zid as the seller's legal representative through it (ZD-S-0989), is the platform's own marketplace for buyers: Salla's Mahally, "a discovery and sales channel connected to Salla merchants" (SA-S-0005), and Shopify's Shop (SH-S-0723). Its place is the dashboard's Sales platforms (منصات البيع, ZD-S-0985), which CM-CHN-001, the parent, also cites.

A join on role, a reading: Zid's Marketplaces, "Sold on Amazon and Trendyol and Jahez" (ZD-S-0458), whose integration "uses APIs to sync data between Zid's system and the sales channel's system" (ZD-S-1065), and whose orders carry is_marketplace_order (ZD-S-0995), is Shopify's Marketplace Connect, connecting the catalog to marketplaces and syncing orders (SH-S-0727), and Salla's الربط بمنصات التسوّق العالمية (SA-S-2195). Its term منصات البيع is the dashboard section that also holds Mazeed (CM-CHN-001, CM-CHN-002); every statement of the concern is cited here, so the fit is clean.

Joined by terms: Zid's mobile app (تطبيق الجوال; staff permission manage.store.ecosystem.mobileapps, Mobile app service, ZD-S-0500), "an app for your store" built by عناقيد التطبيقات (ZD-S-1081) and reached from Zid's App Market (ZD-S-1082), is Salla's Mobile app (SA-S-1837) and Shopify's Mobile app builder apps (SH-S-2701). A reading.
